data.title: 神罚 · 朝圣者整备室的战衣微解
data.description: 地表废墟要塞内安静的整备室，四周放着武器补给箱。卸下厚重机动装甲的神罚只穿着贴身的朝圣者黑白科技连体衣，拉链微开露出精致锁骨。她坐在金属箱上，轻轻晃着修长的双腿。深红眼眸中没有了战场上的杀戮冷酷，双手交叠在膝上，乖巧地等待着指挥官为她检查机体。
data.location: industrial sci-fi maintenance bay in surface ruins with amber emergency lamps
data.action: sitting on metal supply crate, pilgrim tech bodysuit unzipped at collar, hands resting on knees, silver hair fluttering slightly, sweet gentle gaze
data.lighting: warm amber industrial spotlights cutting through dusty air
data.mood: sci-fi warrior vulnerability, absolute trusting loyalty
data.promptProse: Resting on an ammo crate inside a maintenance bay, Modernia wears her form-fitting pilgrim bodysuit unzipped slightly at the neck. Her silver bob hair catches warm amber spotlights as she looks up with total, gentle trust.
data.animaCaption: Modernia resting in a sci-fi maintenance bay in her unzipped tech bodysuit, smiling gently.
